significance: The Paadal Petra Sthalam of the Kongu country at Venjamangudalur in Karur district, over twelve centuries old with rock inscriptions of the Pandya period; Sundarar composed a Tevaram pathigam here.
story: Shiva, in the guise of a priest, is said to have blessed Sundarar with gold at this shrine first raised by the hunter-king Venchan.
